name: Docs only
author: Example
description: A rule pack for an agent that writes documentation: it may edit only in docs/, and asks before touching docs/legal/.

rulePacks.label: Docs only
rulePacks.description: Edits only in docs/. Edits in docs/legal/ ask you first.
rulePacks.instructions: You work on the documentation in docs/ only. Do not change code or settings; if a code change is needed, describe it in your reply instead. Files in docs/legal/ are reviewed by people: change them only when asked, and keep their wording otherwise.
